decisions.reason: The existing Event should record custom stainless-steel spouts as an exception without erasing the standing policy to use off-the-shelf electronic components where practical.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Please do this. Make it look as close as possible. I really like the look and functionality of the render. Also, one difference from the rendering. The plate on the back of the machine that reads "Karla's Matcha Mixer", place that on the front. The spout and the mixers would be in front of the baristas but the customer would see it from a different angle. I want "Karla's Matcha Mixer to face the customer.

value_updates.sourcing_policy: Use off-the-shelf electronic components where practical, with custom-fabricated stainless-steel render-style dispensing spouts as a V1 exception.

decisions.reason: The client clearly accepts custom stainless-steel render-style spouts, but it is unclear whether the reply also accepts the earlier button-operated solenoid proposal as a new dispensing requirement.
Changing the spout construction and appearance does not alter the existing leak-prevention requirements.
The customer-facing placard placement is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
Render-style spout construction does not change the independently defined splash-control target for mixing.
The component-selection and BOM deliverable remains required unchanged; the source does not modify its deliverable or selection goal.
Custom stainless-steel spout construction does not change the existing removability or flush-cleaning requirements.
The source does not change the established beige and green color scheme.
The request for render-like spout appearance remains compatible with and does not modify the established DJ-turntable-inspired identity.
The source does not change bowl capacity, depth, or form.
The system-layout and CAD deliverable remains unchanged; the concrete spout and placard decisions are owned by their atomic product Requirements.
The client source does not specify a wiring-plan change, and accepting custom stainless-steel spout fabrication alone does not necessarily alter the wiring deliverable.
